overall_reason: The page chrome is two systems stitched together: a Webflow navbar on black text and zinc borders, and a React app on Tailwind gray text and borders with stone fills, so one page carries three neutral families and six radii.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT passes (spacing 93% on 4px, type 100% on token values); T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-DRIFT-PAIRS fail on neutrals, borders and radii across the two halves (TOK-013, TOK-010, TOK-004).

findings.where: navbar against breadcrumb, tabs and sidebar, 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: The Webflow navbar sets links in #000000 with a #e4e4e7 (Tailwind zinc) bottom border, a #d4d4d8 search border and an #efeff4 kbd chip; the app below sets tab text in #030712 and #4b5563, the breadcrumb in #808080, borders in #e5e7eb (Tailwind gray) and #dfe0e5, and the featured card fill in #f5f5f4 (Tailwind stone) (values.1440 colour examples). The sweep's stock_swatches hit flags Tailwind default tokens.
findings.before: Gray, zinc and stone neutrals plus #808080 and #000000 on one screen
findings.after: One neutral ramp: navbar, breadcrumb, tabs and cards read the same ink, muted-text and border tokens
findings.why: Visitors see slightly different greys and blacks in each strip, so the header and the app read as two products.
findings.root: navbar built outside the app's token set

findings.evidence: Borders pair #e5e7eb (10 elements) with #e4e4e7 (2) at 0.008 OKLab, plus #dfe0e5 on the breadcrumb bar; fills pair #ffffff with #f9fafb and #fafafb, and #f5f5f4 with #efeff4 (values.1440 near_duplicates).
findings.why: Hairlines a hair apart are invisible as a choice and visible as a seam where they meet.

findings.evidence: Six radii render on controls and cards: the kbd chip 4px, the nav toggle 6px, the search field 8px, the email cards 12px, the sidebar ad 16px, and full pills (values.1440.radius examples).
findings.why: Neighbouring controls with 4, 6 and 8px corners look like parts from three kits.

findings.evidence: Secondary text uses five greys: #6b7280 (11 elements), #4b5563 (5), #000000 at 0.60 (4), #808080 (3) and #78716c (1) (values.1440.colour_text).
findings.after: Two text roles below the ink: muted and subtle
findings.why: Five greys for two jobs make the hierarchy of labels unreadable.

findings.evidence: Of 942 declared tokens, 588 are never referenced (tokens.own_tokens_never_referenced), and several carry hashed names such as --bzTONN, --ujwXi and --cgpxvS that hold stock Tailwind swatches (#8b5cf6, #6366f1, #3b82f6).
findings.before: Hashed, value-holding token names and 588 unused tokens
findings.after: Role names (--accent, --muted) and the unused tokens removed
findings.why: Hashed names cannot tell the next designer which role a colour plays.

strengths: Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.931 against chance 0.3) and 94% equals a token value.
Type uses five sizes (12, 14, 16, 20, 30px), all on token values, in one family (Inter).
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the featured email is rendered in an iframe (23 iframe references in dom-1440.json); its values are an exhibit and were not measured
the sidebar advertisement is third-party creative and was not judged
T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the stylesheet
